text:
Viper Island is an island of the Andaman Islands. It belongs to the South Andaman district of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands of India.
The island lies 4 km (2 mi) west of Sri Vijaya Puram.

--- Practical Travel Context (Wikivoyage) ---
Port Blair (officially Sri Vijaya Puram) is the capital and largest city of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands group, with a population of around 100,000.
best_time: October to March (pleasant weather, ideal for heritage monuments, wildlife, and cultural walks)
